Summary: This instruction revokes Instruction No. 7/2019 and concerns financial information, prudential standards, credit securitisation and supervision.
title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 8/2026

Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out guidelines specifying when a supplement to a base prospectus introduces a new type of security, aiming to promote consistent supervision and regulatory convergence across the EU.
title: Final Report on the Guidelines on supplements which introduce new securities to a base prospectus

Summary: ESMA’s final report presents revised CSDR guidelines on arrangements, communication procedures and messaging protocols for investment firms and their professional clients, including the use of electronic and international open standards.
title: Final report on the revised CSDR Guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols used between investment firms and their professional clients

Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: The report identifies extreme heat as the leading climate-related liability risk for life and health insurers and occupational pension providers, noting that current financial impacts are limited but risks are expected to increase in coming decades.
title: EIOPA Report on the impacts of climate change on life and health and potential emerging risks for the insurance and IORP sectors

Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out regulatory technical standards specifying requirements for post-trade risk reduction services and exercises to qualify for the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR, including provider operating conditions and monitoring of the exemption.
title: Final report on the Regulatory Standards on the requirements for Post-Trade Risk Reduction services for the purpose of the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR

Summary: ESMA presents its final approach to revising the MAR Guidelines on delay in disclosing inside information, addressing protracted processes, confidentiality orders, information gathering, business opportunities, legitimate interests and situations likely to mislead the public.
title: Final report on the MAR Guidelines on delay in the disclosure of inside information

Issuer: Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários (CMVM)
Summary: The circular sets out CMVM’s expectations for venture capital alternative investment fund managers on prudential requirements and marketing practices, including governance and risk management, investment eligibility and limits, investor information and suitability, third-party referrals, and costs and charges.
title: Circular 007/2026 - Gestão de Ativos - Deveres em matéria de requisitos prudenciais e práticas de comercialização para os organismos de investimento alternativo de capital de risco

Summary: Following the FATF’s June 2026 plenary communications, the circular informs institutions of risk-proportionate countermeasures concerning North Korea and Iran and the continued suspension of Russia’s membership status.
title: Carta Circular n.º CC/2026/00000021

Summary: The final report sets out guidelines for financial entities to manage risks arising from third-party arrangements for non-ICT services, with stricter requirements for services supporting critical or important functions and supervisory attention to concentration risk.
title: Final report on Guidelines on the sound management of third-party risk related to non-ICT services

Summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks arising when banking CSDs provide cash accounts to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes to EU legislation.
title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’
